backend/main.mo: Minimal Motoko actor with no logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence listing two features with referenced files and metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing summaries of various frontend files for reference.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry with SEO metadata, preload, and structured data.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top-level React app composing landing page sections and providers.
frontend/src/components/common/IconBadge: Reusable icon badge component with size and variant styling.
frontend/src/components/common/InlineIco: Lightweight wrapper to render Lucide icons inline with custom classes.
frontend/src/components/common/LogoWithB: Component rendering logo inside a styled container with size options.
frontend/src/components/floating/Floatin: Floating WhatsApp and call buttons with premium styling.
frontend/src/components/landing/Appointm: Booking form with validation, WhatsApp submission, and scroll reveal.
frontend/src/components/landing/AreasSer: Displays Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar service areas with scroll reveal.
frontend/src/components/landing/Footer.t: Renders the site footer with company info, social links, quick navigation links, and contact details using scroll reveal animations.
frontend/src/components/landing/GoogleRe: Displays a Google reviews section with rating, sample review cards, and scroll‑revealed animations.
frontend/src/components/landing/Header.t: Provides the top navigation bar with logo, localized nav links, language selector, and call/WhatsApp buttons.
frontend/src/components/landing/Hero.tsx: Shows the hero section with background image, localized title text, feature chips, benefits list, and CTA buttons.
frontend/src/components/landing/LivePhot: Renders a gallery of live cleaning photos with optional labels and scroll‑staggered card animations.
frontend/src/components/landing/ServiceC: Displays a banner highlighting service coverage areas with localized text and an illustrative image.
frontend/src/components/landing/Services: Renders a list of service cards with themed styling, localized text, pricing, and scroll-reveal animations.
frontend/src/components/landing/SofaPric: Provides an interactive slider to estimate sofa cleaning cost and includes call/WhatsApp CTA buttons.
frontend/src/components/landing/WhyChoos: Displays a grid of feature cards highlighting service advantages with icons, i18n text, and reveal animations.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity authentication, providing identity state, login/logout functions, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/usePrefersReducedMoti: Detects the user's prefers-reduced-motion setting and updates state on media query changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollReveal.ts: Implements scroll-triggered reveal animations with stagger support, reduced-motion handling, and cleanup.
frontend/src/i18n/I18nProvider.tsx: Provides locale state, persistence, and translated strings to the app through context.
frontend/src/i18n/translations.ts: Defines locale types and a large structured interface describing all translation keys for UI sections.
frontend/src/i18n/useI18n.ts: Provides a React hook to access the I18n context and enforce provider usage.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind base styles and custom OKLCH theme variables, plus utility classes for premium UI effects.
frontend/src/lib/whatsappBooking.ts: Formats booking details into a WhatsApp message and generates a prefilled WhatsApp URL.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app root with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, radii, shadows, and enabling plugins.
project_state.json: Metadata describing project scope, requirements, issues, and current architectural state.
